title: Blow-up maps preserve Hⁿ-null sets
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, λ ∈ ℝ with λ ≠ 0, and E ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(E) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then Hⁿ(η_{x,λ}(E)) = 0. Here η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹(y − x) is SimonGMT's blowUpMap x λ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), lam ≠ 0 → μHE[n] E = 0 → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x lam '' E) = 0
